name: Germany
shortSummary: Germany is India's largest trading partner in the European Union, with a Strategic Partnership spanning skilled migration, green hydrogen, and substantial German industrial investment in India.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The 2022 mobility partnership addresses German demand for skilled Indian professionals.
German development financing supports Indian clean-energy infrastructure.

recentDevelopments.title: Skilled migration and green energy financing expand
recentDevelopments.description: Implementation of the 2022 migration and mobility partnership continued alongside German financing for Indian green hydrogen projects.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reflects Germany's growing role as both a labour-market partner and a green-transition financier for India.

historicalEvents.description: India and Germany establish a Strategic Partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Migration and Mobility Partnership Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India and Germany sign an agreement to facilitate skilled migration amid Germany's labour shortages.

historicalEvents.title: Green and Sustainable Development Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Germany commits substantial financing toward Indian green hydrogen and renewable energy projects.
